label: list
definition: An ordered, mutable Python collection.

label: dictionary
definition: A Python mapping from unique keys to values.

label: set
definition: A collection of unique hashable values, useful for membership and deduplication.

label: exception
definition: A runtime error object that can be raised and handled explicitly.

label: grain
definition: The exact business meaning of one row in a dataset or query result.

label: HAVING
definition: A SQL clause that filters groups after aggregation.

label: window function
definition: A SQL calculation across related rows that preserves the input row count.
example: ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY updated_at DESC)

label: join fan-out
definition: Row multiplication caused by matching one input row to multiple rows on the other side of a join.
example: one order joined to three order lines becomes three rows

label: groupby
definition: A Pandas split-apply-combine operation used to aggregate rows by one or more keys.

label: merge
definition: A Pandas join operation that combines DataFrames using key columns.

label: shuffle
definition: Redistribution of Spark records across partitions, commonly caused by grouping or joins.

label: data skew
definition: Uneven distribution of records across keys or partitions that can create slow straggler tasks.
example: one hot customer_id owns most rows

label: lazy evaluation
definition: Spark transformations build a plan; execution normally starts only when an action requires a result.

label: idempotency
definition: A property where repeating the same logical operation does not create additional unintended effects.
example: reloading the same daily partition yields one correct partition

label: watermark
definition: A recorded boundary that identifies how far a source has been processed.

label: replay
definition: Reprocessing a known source range or batch after failure or correction.
example: rerun batch 2026-09-20 after fixing a transient sink error

label: Bronze layer
definition: A medallion layer that keeps source-shaped or minimally processed data.

label: Silver layer
definition: A medallion layer for cleaned, validated and conformed data.

label: Gold layer
definition: A medallion layer optimized for business consumption or analytics use cases.

label: SCD Type 2
definition: A dimensional modeling technique that preserves historical versions of changed dimension attributes.
example: new surrogate key and validity range for each customer version

label: datakilde
definition: Norwegian term for data source.
example: Vi leser data fra en ekstern datakilde.

label: datakvalitet
definition: Norwegian term for data quality.

label: arbeidsflyt
definition: Norwegian term for workflow.

label: STAR
definition: A structured interview answer format: Situation, Task, Action, Result.
example: Describe the context, your responsibility, your actions and the measurable outcome.
